name: Mesilla Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A two-state AVA along the Rio Grande, from north of Las Cruces, New Mexico, into El Paso County, Texas. It was the first AVA in both states. The climate is dry and hot, and Cabernet Sauvignon, Zinfandel and Syrah are the most important grapes.
